description: Unlinks a MAX account from the Statuser account. Notifications will stop going to it; notification rules stop including it. If the account was the 2FA channel, its 2FA role is cleared automatically — but it is recommended to first switch the second factor via another channel if no other 2FA channel is configured.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: max_unlink
title: Unlink MAX account
